title: Rags and the Shithouse Rag
summary: The pianists also played their own rags; Amacker describes a popular rag and who featured it, including Sam Henry and Lulu.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Did any of them just play blues and couldn't play anything else?

No. Most of them could play a lot of their own make-up rags. Hundreds of different kinds of rags. Used to be a rag in that day. A very popular rag in that day, I don't like to use the word, but a very popular rag in that day made a lot of money off it. Used to go to the shithouse rag. Same to say that, but the fellas used that word down there, they used to be shithouse rag.
The shithouse rag. Can you play it today? No, not on this guitar.
Yeah, but I mean on the piano. Yeah, I played on the piano. And who featured that?

Well people like Sam Henry, that's what I named that, Sam Henry. He featured things like that. I played stuff on the piano. It's what Sam Henry I mentioned, he featured that. The kitchen, Sam Henry. Lulu, you know the fella called Lulu. He was a man but they called him Lulu. He featured things like that, he featured like that. He's a man but I didn't call him Lulu. He was a French fella I think? No, no, that's his name for some reason.
